purpose: Evaluate the discovery-only empirical_profile_cards_v2 prompt wording on a fixed held-out sample that excludes every participant and response row used by the frozen v1 diagnostic.

conditions.description: An anonymized participant background plus the discovery-only empirical_profile_cards_v2 prompt card.

sampling.unknown_status_policy: Unknown is not a dedicated stratum because it is sparse in the released held-out data; it may appear only through the random_remaining slot.

labels: No, but ask me next time
Yes, but ask me next time

guardrails: Only rows marked heldout in empirical_response_splits.csv are evaluation targets.
Human label_id and label_text are kept outside the inference plan and are never included in a QSTN prompt.
Every participant and response row selected by v1 is excluded before v2 sampling; the v1 diagnostic remains frozen.
V2 wording is constrained only by discovery-derived cluster centers; no held-out label, prediction, or metric is used as prompt-card evidence.
The 90-row result is a pre-RL quality gate, not a population estimate, a causal card ablation, or proof of general human-likeness.
